properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): a single indivisible top-level part always carries a hierarchy finding — declared `component` it trips level_spine_disagreement (a non-top root while `system` exists), declared `system` it trips orphan_level (above rank 0, no parent, no child) — unless the Project CONTAINS it, which both rules accept and neither message names
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL on xrt-demo F11 (cmp:agent-seam), 2026-09-16. ① OBSERVED: with `level: component` → "declares level 'component' but sits at the ROOT of the spine, while 'system' exists above it"; with `level: system` → "is not contained by anything above it and contains nothing below it". The reporter: "There is no third option." Expected: a way to say "atomic and top-level" once. NOT affected: designs whose top rung is the finest, or where every root has children.

② PRECEDENT: none for the pair; chg:accept-09bee61653a4e59a records level_spine_disagreement as "self-limiting — it compares against the highest level PRESENT". ③ CANDIDATES: (a) the exemptions are disjoint — orphan_level exempts rank 0 only, the spine rule exempts rank ≥ top only, so a top-rank node with no children and no parent escapes the spine rule and trips orphan_level, and a bottom-rank root escapes orphan_level and trips the spine rule; (b) the ladder is wrong for the design; (c) the part is not CONTAINED BY THE PROJECT, and both rules count a Project parent as "higher"; (d) the observation is wrong. ④ ⑤ MEASURED in hierarchy.rs (read 2026-09-16): orphan_level's has_higher_parent accepts `projects.contains(&e.from_id)`; level_spine_disagreement's has_parent accepts the same. So a top-rung childless part that the Project CONTAINS trips NEITHER rule — the "third option" exists and is the genesis skill's own instruction ("contains each new node under the Project"). Whether cmp:agent-seam carried a Project CONTAINS edge is not in the report; if it did not, (c) is the cause and (a) is latent; if it did, (a) is the cause. One get_node in xrt-demo's graph decides it. (d) refuted by the two verbatim messages.

⑥ CLASS: a detector message that names the condition and not the cure — "not contained by anything above it" without saying the Project can contain it — so the reporter reached for the level field, the one knob the message mentioned, and found both settings wrong. Same class as the 2026-09-14 register finding: the design holds the answer and the words do not carry it. ⑦ PIN: a Project containing one top-rung part with no children raises nothing; the same part uncontained raises exactly one finding whose message names `contains` under the Project. ⑧ FIX (his word, after the measurement): orphan_level's message says "contain it under the Project with `contains` if it is a top-level part"; and if the joint case is real, exempt a top-rung childless node the Project contains — which today's code already does. ⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: the CONTAINS state of cmp:agent-seam.
